description: Find Polymarket, Polymarket US and Kalshi markets by words in the title, an exact market id, a Kalshi series, event or market ticker, or a market link. Returns each market's venue, id, title, open or closed status, Yes price and RulesWatch link, and a few recent rule edits on matching titles. Use it to find a market's venue and id from its name or link.

query.description: One or two distinctive title words ("Fed rate", "Senate Ohio"), a market id, a Kalshi ticker, or a Polymarket, Polymarket US, Kalshi or RulesWatch market link.

venue.description: Only markets on this venue: pm (or polymarket), pmus or kalshi. Leave out for all.

name: search_markets
title: Search markets
